cost: Local runtime only. Azure marginal/allocated costs unavailable; do not report zero cloud cost.
lakehouse_publication: Validated per-table Iceberg snapshot manifest, atomic local active-publication pointer, writer lock, and retained committed ancestry. Consumers may pin a publication ID across datasets.
publication: SQLite transaction commits raw batch, Silver, both Gold tables, active publication, and committed run together. Failed attempt evidence recorded separately.
recovery: New attempt UUID, stable batch/run identity; transactionally publish both Gold datasets; reject manifest mutation and out-of-order delta parents.
resource_profile: single local Python process; full recomputation; not a scale benchmark
target_engine: dbt + Trino + Iceberg, available through the optional local lakehouse path
